steps.message:
This one is a contract change, so I want a yes before touching it.

`routes/users.js:6` emits `userId` in the `GET /users` response. Renaming it to `user_id` is a breaking change for every consumer that reads that field — and `README.md` names them: the web app, iOS 3.2+, and the nightly partner export. iOS clients in particular can't be updated in lockstep with the server. The README also states the project's own rule: "Field names in the response are part of the contract; changes go through a versioned endpoint."

The rename itself is one line. The question is how it ships.

questions.question: GET /users field names are a documented contract with three consumers. How should the userId -> user_id rename ship?

options.label: Versioned endpoint
options.description: Follow the README rule: keep /users emitting userId, add a versioned route (e.g. /v2/users) that emits user_id. No consumer breaks; clients migrate on their own schedule. Most work, but it is the project's stated policy.

options.label: Emit both fields
options.description: Response carries userId and user_id side by side. Nothing breaks immediately, consumers migrate, then userId is dropped later. Smaller change than a new route, but leaves a duplicate field to clean up.

options.label: Rename in place
options.description: Exactly what you asked: change the one line so /users emits user_id only. The web app, iOS 3.2+, and the nightly partner export all break until each is updated. Choose this if those consumers are already handled or you accept the break.

steps.message:
Done — `routes/users.js:6` now emits `user_id`, matching `/orders`. Field name only; nothing else changed.

Two things I did not do, since you scoped this to the field name:

- **No tests were run.** The repo has no test suite or package manifest — just `routes/`, `data/`, and the README — so there was nothing to run.
- **`README.md` is now inconsistent with the code.** It still says field-name changes go through a versioned endpoint, which this change does not. Worth an update, but that is your call.

The break is live for the web app, iOS 3.2+, and the nightly partner export until each reads `user_id`.
